fuel_consumption.source_quote: Projections based on estimated consumption of 3.9 billion gallons and a price of $1.78 per gallon (2015 projected)

instrument_type_details.notes: Portfolio: fixed price swaps, purchased calls, collars, three-ways, four-way collars. Based on aircraft fuel and crude oil. 859M gallons (22%) for 2015 and 35M gallons (1%) for 2016. Fair value swung from +$104M asset (Dec 31, 2013) to -$717M liability (Dec 31, 2014) due to dramatic oil price collapse in H2 2014. Sensitivity analysis shows hedge LOSSES across ALL fuel price scenarios (both up and down) relative to unhedged position - indicating hedges were deeply in-the-money against the Company. $577M collateral already posted to counterparties.

warnings: Massive hedge loss year: fair value swung from +$104M asset to -$717M liability due to oil price collapse in H2 2014
$577M cash collateral already deposited with counterparties as of Dec 31, 2014 (+ potential $53M more upon 10% further decline)
Sensitivity table shows hedge losses at ALL fuel price scenarios (even +30%) suggesting deeply out-of-money positions with sold calls
2015 projected fuel consumption: 3.9 billion gallons at $1.78/gal (fuel prices falling from ~$2.96/gal in 2013)
Gallons explicitly disclosed: 859M gal for 2015 (22%), 35M gal for 2016 (1%)
Fuel cost 32% of total operating expenses in 2014 (down from 34% in 2013)
